case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
sup:70510.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
sup:70510.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We take the copper development seriously. Our data shows a more balanced picture:

Your quality was 273 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70510@2026Q3).

German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

We have therefore prepared a structured set of options that should be easy to take to your pricing committee.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 339.74; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 329.81; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 337.49; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

Option A and Option B answer your side's interest in a different payment profile, so you can choose what suits you best. If your committee needs any further information, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We offer a price of €372.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We have reviewed your data regarding labour costs and quality; however, these factors do not offset the substantial impact of copper prices on our manufacturing costs. You mentioned that your data shows a more balanced picture regarding copper development; please provide this documentation for our review. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

In the meantime, we are prepared to revise our offer to €370.55 per unit for payment within 30 days. Specifically, as an alternative at our standard terms, we can provide a price of €370.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Quality Management: We meet the agreed quality targets.

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and appreciate your constructive approach to our relationship. 

However, we still require the documentation regarding your data on copper development to consider your perspective. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our current Angebot is a price of €371.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. In the meantime, we can offer an alternative at our standard terms: a price of €369.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
